examples.label: Editor quick-actions button floating over the dashboard
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-speed-dial" site="Global" id="speeddial-editor-actions" icon="hero-plus" icon_animated size="large" variant="default" color="primary">
  <:item icon="hero-pencil-square" href="/admin/articles/new" color="primary" />
  <:item icon="hero-photo" href="/admin/media/upload" color="info" />
  <:item icon="hero-user-plus" href="/admin/team/invite" color="success" />
  <:item icon="hero-calendar-days" href="/admin/schedule" color="warning" />
</.component>

examples.label: Share menu that opens to the left of its trigger
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-speed-dial" site="Global" id="speeddial-share-post" icon="hero-share" wrapper_position="left" size="medium" space="small" variant="default" color="dark">
  <:item icon="hero-link" href="/share/copy-link" color="natural" />
  <:item icon="hero-envelope" href="/share/email" color="natural" />
  <:item icon="hero-printer" href="/share/print" color="natural" />
</.component>

examples.label: Support launcher in the bottom-left corner with labelled actions
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-speed-dial" site="Global" id="speeddial-support-launcher" action_position="bottom-start" clickable width="medium" padding="small" size="large" variant="shadow" color="success">
  <:trigger_content class="text-xs font-semibold">Help</:trigger_content>
  <:item href="/support/chat" content_class="px-3 py-2" color="white" variant="default">Chat with us</:item>
  <:item href="/docs" content_class="px-3 py-2" color="white" variant="default">Read the docs</:item>
  <:item href="/support/ticket" content_class="px-3 py-2" color="white" variant="default">Open a ticket</:item>
</.component>
